paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This line plot, from the paper “Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine Translation” and associated with the IWSLT14 De dataset, illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) on the x-axis and BLEU score on the y-axis for four different training strategies. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from approximately 1 to 9 with tick marks at integer intervals (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9), and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 20 to 32 with major tick marks at intervals of 2 (20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32), also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple dotted line with circle markers) starts at BLEU ≈20.5 at AL=1 and rises to ≈31.5 at AL=9; “Inconsistency-CE” (purple dashed line with square markers) begins at BLEU ≈23 at AL=2 and increases to ≈31.2 at AL=9; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue dash-dot line with square markers) starts at BLEU ≈23 at AL=2 and reaches ≈31.8 at AL=9; and “Consistency-Bi” (red solid line with star markers) begins at BLEU ≈26 at AL=2 and climbs to ≈32.2 at AL=9. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend, with “Consistency-Bi” consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across the range of AL values shown.
